implementation.gap_definition: (current session open - previous completed RTH session close) / previous completed RTH session high-low range
implementation.signal_time: close of bar_in_session=3, the fourth completed 5-minute bar
implementation.direction: opposite the sign of the opening gap
implementation.executable_target: entry + direction * abs(entry - target_reference), matching the canonical engine
implementation.stop: entry - direction * max(abs(entry - target_reference), causal intraday ATR on the completed signal bar)
implementation.risk_unit: trade net PnL USD divided by previous completed session Wilder ATR14 times contract point value

A0_MNQ.review_note: N and threshold were frozen on 2026-10-09 by applying the unchanged Phase-2 power and one-sided abandonment formulas to the already-reported MNQ OOS distribution.

common_forward_governance.power: one-sided alpha 10%, 80% power against zero using the locked OOS mean and standard deviation
common_forward_governance.review_timing: one review when the series first reaches its own review_N completed forward trades
common_forward_governance.kill_switch: after 365 elapsed calendar days, stop if cumulative net_R over trades closed in the trailing 365 calendar days is strictly negative
common_forward_governance.allocation: zero; shadow tracking only until a separate explicit promotion decision
common_forward_governance.independence: NQ and MNQ are two implementations of the same economic alpha and must not be counted as two independent sleeves
